newsitem.title: CHINA: China congratulates Clinton on re-election.
newsitem.headline: China congratulates Clinton on re-election.

text.p: China congratulated U.S. President Bill Clinton on his re-election on Wednesday and said it was ready to work with the United States for further progress.
"We wish to congratulate President Clinton on his re-election," Foreign Ministry spokesman Cui Tiankai told reporters.
"We are ready to work with the U.S. side for further progress on the basis of the three joint communiques," Cui said.
The communiques were reached between the U.S. and China as part of the rapprochement which began in the early 1970s and led to diplomatic recognition in 1979.
"Now, a good opportunity has presented itself for improving and expanding Sino-U.S. relations," the spokesman said.
"Some positive progress has been made in the bilateral relations with somewhat improved atmosphere."
